record.question: Which of the following is not true in regards to Chawngchen zai?
record.explanation: The printed page confirms all four names. Lalvunga zai belongs to Chai hla, whereas Hla tluang, Lumtui zai and Tlangkhaw zai are forms of Chawngchen zai; see the scholarly discussion in https://ijellh.com/papers/2014/july/14-133-140-july-2014.pdf (p. 136) and JH Lalrinzuala’s classification in https://www.researchgate.net/publication/365401251_Lalrinzuala_1_CHAWNGCHEN_ZAI_ZIR_CHIANNA (p. 2).
